title: isolation profile loads both plugins with the intended config

checks.name: agent default model points at the mock local provider
checks.detail:
- id: agent-default-model
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-default-model'
  config:
    provider: mock-local
    model: mock-small
# == @deepseek-ai/dsh-base

checks.name: cloud row session-title-llm is disabled
checks.detail:
- id: session-title-llm
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-title-first-prompt-llm'
  config:
    targetWords: 5
    targetCjkCharacters: 10
    maxInputBytes: 4096
    maxOutputTokens: 4096
    timeoutMs: 60000
  disabled: true
# == @deepseek-ai/dsh-base

checks.name: plugin row mock-provider is registered
checks.detail:
- id: mock-provider
  name: dsh-mock-provider
  config:
    providers:
      - mock-local
      - mock-cloud
    logFile: evidence/e2e/mock-calls.jsonl
    text: mock reply
    retryPolicy:
      mode: normal
      maxRetries: 2
      initialDelayMs: 10
      maxDelayMs: 40

checks.name: plugin row local-first-router is registered
checks.detail:
- id: local-first-router
  name: dsh-local-first-router
  config:
    policy: local-only
    local:
      provider: mock-local
      model: mock-small
    logFile: evidence/e2e/router.jsonl

checks.name: plugin row budget-guard is registered
checks.detail:
- id: budget-guard
  name: dsh-budget-guard
  config:
    mode: enforce
    ledgerFile: evidence/e2e/ledger.jsonl
    logFile: evidence/e2e/guard.jsonl
    perRequestYuan: 0.2
    dailyYuan: 2
    freeProviders:
      - mock-local
    prices:
      mock-cloud:
        inputPerMTok: 2
        outputPerMTok: 8

checks.name: router config carries the local policy and local target
checks.detail:
- id: local-first-router
  name: dsh-local-first-router
  config:
    policy: local-only
    local:
      provider: mock-local
      model: mock-small
    logFile: evidence/e2e/router.jsonl

checks.name: guard config is enforce with ledger and CNY caps
checks.detail:
- id: budget-guard
  name: dsh-budget-guard
  config:
    mode: enforce
    ledgerFile: evidence/e2e/ledger.jsonl
    logFile: evidence/e2e/guard.jsonl
    perRequestYuan: 0.2
    dailyYuan: 2
    freeProviders:
      - mock-local
    prices:
      mock-cloud:
        inputPerMTok: 2
        outputPerMTok: 8

checks.name: mock config lists both scripted providers
checks.detail:
- id: mock-provider
  name: dsh-mock-provider
  config:
    providers:
      - mock-local
      - mock-cloud
    logFile: evidence/e2e/mock-calls.jsonl
    text: mock reply
    retryPolicy:
      mode: normal
      maxRetries: 2
      initialDelayMs: 10
      maxDelayMs: 40

notes: Runtime evidence from dsh a1d1-isolated --dump-config in <test-root>: the loader parsed all three plugin rows and disabled every cloud provider row.
